unit.title: При нажатии на кнопку рисуем на ней

learning_outcomes.statement: Wires each cell button to a click handler that knows its own index, and teaches the late-binding closure pitfall via lambda i=indeks.

reviewers.attestation: Read the unit's canonical source (and, for notebooks, every cell) in full, reproduced every checkable claim under the project's own Python 3.14.6 venv rather than trusting printed output, and assessed pedagogy, coherence, and Russian technical language against the binding M01 rubric. This is an AI-only pass; it cannot issue APPROVED.
